name: Bloodthirster

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Colossal Size
bonuses.text: This Threat is a mighty giant, immensely difficult to kill. It has 50 Wounds.

bonuses.name: Daemon Lord of Khorne
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 5 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Locus of Unbound Fury
bonuses.text: Anyone who makes a melee attack within 10 metres of this Threat (including itself) may reroll any 1s on their Weapon Skill Tests, apart from Complications.

abilities.name: Rage Incarnate
abilities.text: Anyone witnessing a Bloodthirster must make a DN 3 Terror Test. Additionally, anyone who fails must attack the nearest enemy (excluding the Bloodthirster) or ally as if Frenzied.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilities.text: If this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical as part of an attack, the target suffers the Bleeding Condition in addition to any other effects.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 10d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: The Blood Legions
options.text: A Bloodthirster may exchange its Lash for a Bloodflail, or both weapons for a Great Axe.

note: Speed printed 12 (Fly). The sidebar 'The Blood Legions' is kept as a variant option.
